description: Commitment boundary: author withdraws their own provisional statement. Already-promoted statements cannot be withdrawn. Caller must supply the author's signature over the withdrawal payload (canonicalize({action:'withdraw', statement_id})).

author_private_key.description: If provided, tool signs the withdrawal payload with this key.

author_signature.description: Hex Ed25519 signature. If omitted, provide author_private_key and the tool will sign for you.

name: aps_withdraw_provisional
